name: MobileBoost
long_description:
MobileBoost is an AI SDET for iOS and Android apps. An agent turns a plain-language test spec into test code, runs it on simulators and real devices, and fixes it when your app changes. Nobody on your team maintains test scripts by hand. The test code is accessible at any time if your team wants that level of access.

You can start runs from your CI pipeline with the MobileBoost GitHub Action, or let your coding agent start them over MCP while you build.

Mobile teams at Duolingo, Lyft, Wayfair, Flo Health, Noom, Compass, and Redfin use MobileBoost. Duolingo cut manual regression testing by 70%: https://blog.duolingo.com/reduced-regression-testing/

founders.founder_bio:
Christian led Product at HelloFresh (#1 meal kit service, symbol: HFG) for more than 4 years.
Before, he was an Entrepreneur in Residence at Rocket Internet, where he worked in Product roles with Westwing (symbol: WEW), Home24 (symbol: H24), and co-founded PricePanda in South East Asia (which was later merged with getprice.com.au).

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Christian previously founded VOJD, a Lakestar-backed consumer 3D printing venture featured in The New York Times and Wired, and partnered with super influencers such as Virgil Abloh.

Before that, he was an Entrepreneur in Residence at Rocket Internet, where he held sourcing and marketing roles with Global Fashion Group (symbol: GFG) and Payleven, which later merged with SumUp.
